name: iron
lore_descriptor: honest gray, with the faint ring of a forge
first_pickup_chronicle: Iron. Solid. Honest. The dungeon's first lesson in trust. If I lose this, I have lost worse than a weapon — I have lost the floor under my feet.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.00, weight_mult 1.00, no effective_against (T2 core reference). The reference material — the 1.0/1.0 baseline. Peak F8 spread 12 — VERY long tail (still possible at F1, still possible at F40).
